tools.name: crypto_site_check
tools.description: Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact: domain age (RDAP) and first archive date, HTTPS/security, socials (X, Telegram, Discord, GitHub), docs/whitepaper, team page, audit firms mentioned, contract addresses on the page (optionally verifies yours), scam phrases and wallet-drainer signals (seed-phrase inputs), template/free-hosting signs. Returns a 0-100 trust score, red and green flags. Heuristics, not financial advice. Takes 3-8 s. Price: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Pay with access_key (card credits) or x402. Without payment, returns how to pay.

contract.description: Optional token contract address to verify it is published on the site

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
